# dsh-pele-mermaid
简体中文 | English · GitHub · Issues
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Render Mermaid fenced code blocks in the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI as SVG diagrams with
**Pele*
* — no mermaid.js runtime is bundled or loaded.
**Topics:** `deepseek-harness` · `dsh-plugin` · `mermaid` · `plugin`

Pele is the lightweight Mermaid-to-SVG renderer from the
Obsidian team (`pele@1.9.0`, MIT). It suppo

rts the diagram types built into **Mermaid 12.1.0**
and is themed with CSS variables.

Every Mermaid code block gets a **Code / Diagram** toggle, a fullscreen zoom viewer, standalone
SVG

export, DSW theme adaptation, and a clean fallback to source when a diagram cannot be
rendered.

- Package: `dsh-pele-mermaid` `0.1.4`
- Intended profile: `desktop`, owned by the DSH Desktop applic

ation
- Renderer: `pele@1.9.0`, served from a same-origin plugin route
## Features

- Renders `mermaid`, `mermaidjs` and `mmd` fenced code blocks, and also recovers
DSH/Shiki's plain f

allback (a code element with no `language-` class) when Pele recognizes a
Mermaid keyword at the sta

rt of the block.
- Never enhances a code block labelled with another `language-*` class, and never t

ouches inline
`code`.
- **Code / Diagram** toggle buttons with `aria-pressed`; diagram view is the d

efault, and the
original `pre` element is preserved for code view.
- An **icon-only toolbar**: a bad

ge naming the detected diagram type next to "Pele", the
Diagram/Code toggle, then zoom out / zoom in

/ reset, fullscreen and **Download SVG**, split
into two groups by a hairline. Every control is a 1

6px stroked icon whose localized name lives
in `aria-label` and `title`, so the bar stays one row wi

de in a narrow chat column and nothing
is lost to a hover or a screen reader.
- Zoom and pan in plac

e: the **Zoom in / Zoom out / Reset zoom** buttons in the toolbar, hold
`Ctrl` (or `Cmd`) and scroll

the wheel to zoom at the pointer, drag to pan, and use `+`,
`-`, `0` and the arrow keys. A plain wh

eel still scrolls the page. The state is per block and
resets when the diagram re-renders.
- Fullscr

een viewer: zoom in / out / reset / fit, drag to pan, `Ctrl` or `Cmd` + wheel to zoom at
the pointer

, `Escape` to close, focus trapped while open and returned to the trigger on close,
`role="dialog"`

and `aria-modal="true"`. It opens at the inline zoom and restores the inline
scroll position and zoo

m when you close it.
- Exports a standalone `.svg` file named `pele-<type>-YYYYMMDD-HHmmss.svg` whos

e root carries the
resolved theme variables, so it looks the same outside DSH. The export is always

the **whole
diagram at its natural size** — zooming or panning first does not crop it.
- Adapts to t

he DSW light and dark themes by mapping DSW design tokens onto Pele CSS variables.
Colour changes ne

ed no re-render; geometry-only changes re-render the affected diagrams.
- Falls back to the diagram

source with a localized error message — including Pele's line and
column when it provides them — ins

tead of leaving a broken diagram.
[该节后续省略]
## Requirements

- The DSH Web GUI with the `desktop` profile. This release was verified against the bundled
desktop

runtime `0.2.1-rc.2` (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop` and `@deepseek-ai/dsh` `0.2.1-rc.2`)
and the standa

lone `dsh` CLI `0.1.7-rc.1`.
- Node.js 22.18 or later for building from source (the version this rel

ease was built and tested with); the package declares
`engines.node >= 22.18.0`.
- DSH is a develope
r preview. Its plugin loader and Markdown DOM may change between releases.
## Install

The plugin ships as a DSH profile plugin bundle. Its `package.json` declares
`dsh.bundle.patch = ./c
ordis.patch.yml`, which inserts the bundle entry `ui-pele-mermaid`.
## Architecture
The package is a dual-face DSH plugin bundle:

- **Host face** — `lib/index.js` is a Cordis (Node) plugin that injects `webServer` and
registers on

e exact route, `/dsh-pele-mermaid/pele-runtime.js`. A `GET` or `HEAD` request
gets the vendored Pele

script as `text/javascript` with an immutable cache header; anything
else gets 404 or 405. The rout

e is registered inside `ctx.effect(...)` so it is removed on
disposal.
- **Client face** — `lib/clie

nt.js` registers itself with the DSH client module loader as
`@lsy1998/dsh-pele-mermaid` (the packag

e name; the loader matches it against each boot-graph
row's id). It does **not** bundle Pele. The fi

rst detected Mermaid block injects
`<script data-dsh-pele-runtime src="/dsh-pele-mermaid/pele-runtim

e.js">`; the loader is
idempotent, dedupes concurrent calls, and `window.pele` becomes the Pele inst

ance.
- **Runtime copy** — `lib/pele-runtime.js` is an **unmodified copy** of
`node_modules/pele/dis

t/pele.global.js` from `pele@1.9.0` (706,153 bytes, sha256
`323c16de7844d4b609743f70449ebce041a531e4

f48f23b1e9e7ec9d3b917287`). The build copies it
byte-for-byte; it is generated, never hand-edited.

Published package contents (11 files): `package.json`, `cordis.patch.yml`, `lib/index.js`,
`lib/clie

nt.js`, `lib/pele-runtime.js`, `bin/dsh-pele-mermaid.mjs`, `icon.svg`, `README.md`,
`README.zh-CN.md
`, `CHANGELOG.md` and `LICENSE`.
## Security

Pele escapes diagram text and renders it as SVG shapes, text, links and images; it does not turn
dia

gram source into scripts, event handlers or HTML labels, and JavaScript callbacks in `click`
stateme

nts are ignored. Links are limited to `http`, `https`, `mailto` and `tel` and images to
`http` and `

https`; `javascript:`, `data:` and `vbscript:` are always blocked, and links get
`rel="noopener"`.
This plugin's responsibilities:

- Error messages and diagram source are always written with `textContent`, never `innerHTML`,
becaus

e Pele error messages embed the offending source line.
- The `icons` option returns `null`, so the p

lugin never injects third-party icon markup.
- Pele's own size limits stay in force (50,000-characte

r source by default).
- The Pele runtime is served from the plugin's own same-origin route; no CDN i

e by default).
- The Pele runtime is served from the plugin's own same-origin route; no CDN is used.
## Compatibility

- Pele `1.9.0` (MIT, obsidianmd/pele).
- Mermaid `12.1.0` syntax coverage, which is what Pele implem

ents. Diagram types Pele does not
recognize fall back to source with an `unsupported-diagram` messag

e.
- DSH developer preview. Verified against the bundled desktop runtime `0.2.1-rc.2` and the
`dsh`
CLI `0.1.7-rc.1` on Windows, Node.js v22.18.0, npm 10.9.3 and pnpm 11.21.0.
